terms_chosen.manager: gestor (agent that leads the chat; 'agente gestor', 'Gestor:')
terms_chosen.listing: ficha (a published catalogue entry: 'Actualizar la ficha existente', 'Abrir la ficha')
terms_chosen.brief: contexto ('Contexto del proyecto', 'Contexto de colaboración', 'Contexto') — 'brief' has no settled Spanish product term; 'resumen' collided with the product's summary/breakdown sense, and the one-word heading 'Brief' would be byte-identical to English (IDENTICAL_OK is a gate script), so the proposal's alternate 'Contexto' family was used.
terms_chosen.starter: agente incluido ('Instalado desde un agente incluido')
terms_chosen.roster: composición (hub team member list heading) — 'plantilla' is region-marked (staff roster in Spain, template in much of LatAm).
terms_chosen.delist: retirar del hub ('Retirar agente', 'Agente retirado del hub')
terms_chosen.configuration run: ejecución de configuración (matches the existing audited es copy in the team conflict description)
terms_chosen.rule_fragments: the {label}{rule}. keys gained a colon ('Categorías: {rule}.') and the shared rule_* strings became impersonal ('no se admiten…') because Spanish participles cannot agree with every label's gender and number; the composed sentence stays grammatical for Nombre, Descripción, El cuerpo de instrucciones, Herramientas, Categorías, Etiquetas and Cuándo usarlo
terms_chosen.quotes: typographic quotes are the es “ ” pair in prose; straight quotes survive only where the string delimits literal characters ('/', '\', ':', '-', '.')
